description:
We’re looking for an engineer who can take ownership of designing, deploying and supporting GPU infrastructure for AI laboratories and research computing.

 • Design and deploy Linux\-based GPU and HPC clusters.

 • Automate provisioning and maintenance using Ansible, Python and Bash.
 



 • Run benchmarks, diagnose performance bottlenecks and validate failover.
 



 • Lead technical discussions with customers and OEMs, document deployments and support laboratory administrators.
 



  





 What we’re looking for:
 



 • Proven experience deploying and supporting production HPC or GPU environments.
 



 • Strong Linux administration and troubleshooting skills.
 



 • Hands\-on experience with NVIDIA GPUs and parallel storage, particularly Lustre.
 



 • Understanding of compute, storage and networking dependencies.
 



 • Ability to own technical delivery and resolve complex infrastructure incidents.
 



 Additional experience with InfiniBand, BeeGFS, OpenPBS, NVIDIA AI Enterprise, Prometheus/Grafana, VMware or Proxmox would be valuable.
 



  





 You’ll help build the infrastructure that researchers, faculty and students use for AI development and experimentation.

 The Responsible AI Manager will help build and operationalize Alvarez \& Marsal’s global responsible AI capability from the ground up. The role owns the governance mechanisms that determine how AI is assessed, approved, deployed, monitored, and retired across internal, vendor, and client\-facing use cases. * Build the global AI risk taxonomy, register, monitoring, and audit mechanisms, tracking model drift, performance degradation, data\-control violations, regulatory gaps, and lifecycle accountability.
* Create client AI review processes, delivery playbooks, employee guidelines, and adoption materials that embed responsible AI into project lifecycles and make compliant use practical across practices and regions.
* Prepare executive reporting on AI risk posture, decisions, exceptions, and remediation for the AI Operating Committee, AI Board, and client audiences when required.

* 8–12 years of experience with at least 2 years in AI governance, responsible AI, technology risk, data governance, security/GRC engineering, ML engineering, data engineering, or a closely related technical discipline.
* Demonstrated ability to build governance frameworks, risk programs, compliance functions, policies, standards, controls, and operating models, preferably while standing up a new function or practice.
* Hands\-on understanding of data flows, data architecture, data pipelines, model lifecycles, API and integration architecture, agentic patterns, MCP\-style integrations, cloud residency, and security controls.
* Strong working knowledge of EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, GDPR, India’s DPDP Act, and related global privacy, security, and AI requirements.
* Experience conducting security assessments, controls reviews, governance compliance activities, third\-party/vendor assessments, and risk evaluations with the ability to challenge technical claims.
* Ability to communicate complex technical and governance issues clearly to practitioners, business stakeholders, executive committees, C\-suite leaders, and client audiences.
* Proven ability to influence without authority and drive implementation across matrixed, fast\-paced, geographically distributed professional services environments.



  





**Additional Plus** 



* Consulting or professional services experience in an internal responsible AI function or client advisory role covering AI strategy, risk, compliance, or technology governance.
* Familiarity with enterprise AI and LLM platforms such as Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude, or comparable tools, including confidentiality, residency, and data\-handling considerations.
* Certifications such as GRCP, CIPP, CRISC, IEEE CertifAIEd, Trustworthy AI, or another relevant responsible AI, privacy, security, or risk credential.



  





**What You'll Bring** 



* You bring technical credibility across AI/ML systems, data governance, architecture, security controls, and lifecycle management, enabling you to assess how systems actually work rather than reviewing policy in isolation.
* You bring governance\-building experience, with the judgment to convert regulatory expectations and risk principles into practical standards, decision rights, control points, and operating routines.
* You bring balanced stakeholder leadership, partnering effectively with engineers, data teams, Information Security, Legal, Risk, Compliance, delivery leaders, and executives while maintaining independent challenge.
* You bring an implementation mindset suited to a newly formed, high\-urgency global organization: you can create structure from ambiguity, prioritize material risks, influence without authority, and deliver usable tools that improve adoption and client trust.



  





**Why Join Us** 



* Shape a global responsible AI function at an early stage, defining its charter, roadmap, operating model, controls, and influence across a rapidly growing consulting organization.
* Work alongside senior leaders and global practitioners on AI transformation that directly affects client delivery, firm risk, technology choices, and the future of professional services.
* Grow in an entrepreneurial culture that rewards impact, continuous learning, independent thinking, collaboration, and meaningful contributions to complex business outcomes.
